$comment: Icons that WP Icons must never bundle or download. Read by scripts/sync-packages.js (bundled catalogs, at build time) and by src/includes/Icons/Exclusions.php (CDN catalogs, when a site downloads a newer package). Edit this file, then run `pnpm sync-icons:packages` and rebuild. See config/README.md.

simple-icons.reason: Simple Icons is CC0, but some logos carry their own license in data/simple-icons.json. Logos whose license is non-commercial (NC), no-derivatives (ND), GPL/AGPL-family (not compatible with redistributing them in arbitrary sites and themes) or a custom/trademark-policy license are excluded. Logos with no license field are CC0. Permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, MPL-2.0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, Unlicense) are kept and listed in licenses/simple-icons-icon-licenses.md for attribution.

octicons.reason: GitHub's logos and Copilot marks are trademarks that GitHub's logo policy does not allow in third-party products; Octicons' MIT license does not grant trademark rights.
